en: Black‑and‑white view of a large medieval hilltop castle with thick walls, towers, and steep gabled roofs, surrounded by dense trees and forested hills. Below the fortress stand several late‑19th‑century villa‑style houses and town buildings, giving a layered perspective from the foreground residences up to the castle above. No visible caption or border text appears on the image side.
